name: std::chrono::month::ok
intro: Checks if the month value stored in *this is in the valid range, i.e., [1, 12].

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the month value stored in *this is in the range [1, 12]. Otherwise false.

examples.output:
6: month is valid
0: month is invalid
16: month is invalid
